title: Telecom complaint and service credit assistant
brief: Design a complaint assistant for a telecom provider. Customers report network outages, poor speed and billing errors. The assistant should investigate using account, billing and service records, explain findings and resolve eligible service credits. Larger or unclear refunds need a human supervisor and may wait up to 48 hours. Keep customers informed, avoid duplicate refunds and use only the right customer's active service connection. Propose any missing policies as assumptions, not real company rules.

assumptions.statement: Proposed policy P1: automatic outage credit only, in INR minor units, floor(monthly recurring service charge × verified outage minutes / billing-cycle minutes), limited to INR 500 and remaining cycle service charge. No automated speed or billing-error credit.
assumptions.why: A bounded first release needs a deterministic rule; real policy is unknown.
assumptions.validation: Approve a versioned signed rule, tax treatment, rounding, eligible outage sources and customer notice text.

assumptions.statement: Account and ledger adapters can enforce tenant/customer/active-connection scope, atomic incident-cycle uniqueness, policy/version checks, stable operation IDs and authoritative commit lookup.
assumptions.why: These are required capabilities, not verified API facts.
assumptions.validation: Sandbox contract tests for all listed conditions; disable automatic credits if any capability is absent.

assumptions.statement: Supervisor queue is staffed continuously; acknowledge within 2 elapsed hours, remind at 24 hours and escalate at 48 elapsed hours from intake. Approval is valid for 15 minutes and exact immutable command only.
assumptions.why: The brief permits a 48-hour wait but gives no staffing or approval rules.
assumptions.validation: Staffing roster, outage drills, legal approval of notice timing and authority matrix.

assumptions.statement: Proposed privacy defaults: minimize to complaint-linked fields, no payment instruments, encrypted case records, tenant-scoped access, 90-day case retention and 365-day audit retention subject to legal approval.
assumptions.why: Privacy and retention rules were not supplied.
assumptions.validation: Approve residency, retention, deletion exceptions and access audits.

assumptions.statement: Illustrative budget uses 10000 monthly cases, 90% identity-valid cases, one LLM call per valid case, 2400 input/450 output tokens, USD 1/4 per million input/output tokens; no model retry.
assumptions.why: Allows reproducible budgeting without invented provider prices or traffic.
assumptions.validation: Replace with measured branch mix, tested model quote and token logs before pilot.

assumptions.statement: Notice delivery adapter supports stable notice IDs and lookup after uncertain send; authenticated in-app case status is always available.
assumptions.why: Customers need updates across session expiry.
assumptions.validation: Verify opt-in channels, deduplication, callbacks and readback in sandbox.

items.title: Decision and boundary
items.description: Customers and support staff investigate outages, slow speed and billing errors. Automatic action is a service-ledger credit for a confirmed outage under H1. items.title: Rule and action validation
items.description: P1 in H1 computes integer minor-unit credit: floor(chargeMinor × union outageMinutes / cycleMinutes), then compare raw calculated amount to the 50000 automatic cap. Above cap routes HUMAN. Otherwise use min(calculated,chargeMinor-alreadyCreditedMinor). Requires positive charge/cycle, nonnegative already credited, verified outage minutes 0..cycle length and valid policy. Zero amount is NO_CREDIT. Above automatic cap routes HUMAN before capping, never silently pays a partial amount. Supervisor exception command may specify positive integer amount up to remaining original charge; unsupported cash refunds receive owned manual disposition. Approval binds complete command bytes: tenant/customer/connection, originalChargeId, cycle, outage IDs, amountMinor,currency,reason,allocation,policyVersion,accountVersion,operationId,expiresAt. Any changed field needs new decision. Fresh auth/account/policy/ledger rechecks at writer, including expiry and revocation; missing support BLOCKED.
